CHECK BURST CS-sockets-fix — correct cast staff-tip sockets that sit on the BUTT of the staff instead of its HEAD (Matt: in some directions — maybe North — the cast keys off the bottom of the staff). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-sockets-fix".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/sockets.json (canvas 512×512; cells cast_<D> for D in S SW W NW N NE E SE: sockets = 8 [x,y] per frame, measurements, release_index); frames /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/cast_<D>/frames/cast/<D>/cast_<D>_NN.png (8 RGBA 512×512 each). Frozen instrument /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/oracle/staff_tip.py (tip(rgba) → tip + slope; alpha-only, it cannot tell head from butt). Conductor evidence: socket jumps between consecutive frames — cast_N f3→f4 190 px and f6→f7 172 px (frames 4–6 on the butt: at f4/f5 the staff is held horizontally and the glowing crystal head is at the RIGHT end while the socket is at the LEFT end); cast_SE f4→f5 150 px; cast_NE f0→f1 117 px. python glue PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — BOTH ENDS per frame: take the staff line through the instrument's tip with its slope (vertical if slope None); collect opaque (alpha ≥ 128) pixels within 3 px of that line whose local opaque width across the line is ≤ 12 px (the thin shaft, not the body); the two extreme projections along the line are END A and END B (report both). If fewer than 40 shaft pixels, mark the frame 'unevaluable' and keep the original socket.
STEP 2 — HEAD CUE per end: in a disc of radius 14 px centred 6 px inward from the end: the HEAD is the ornamented crystal/metal fitting — cool or neutral light pixels (HSV value ≥ 0.55 with hue outside 15°–50° or saturation ≤ 0.25), purple/violet pixels (hue 250°–320°) or glow (value ≥ 0.85); the BUTT is a small brass/orange ferrule (hue 20°–45°, saturation ≥ 0.45) on dark brown wood. head_score = (cool/purple/glow pixel share) − (brass pixel share).
STEP 3 — CONSISTENT ASSIGNMENT per cell with a 2-state Viterbi over the 8 frames (state = which end is the head): unary cost = −4·(head_score of the chosen end − head_score of the other end); transition cost = |head_t − head_{t−1}| / 60 px. Report the chosen head per frame, its margin, and every frame whose head differs from the original socket by > 40 px (CHANGED).
STEP 4 — OUTPUTS: out/sockets.json = the SAME schema as the input (version, canvas, cells{sockets, measurements, release_index}) with corrected sockets; each measurement gains fields end_a, end_b, head_score_a, head_score_b, chosen ('a'|'b'|'original'), changed (bool). out/sockets_sheet.png: for each cell a row of its 8 frames on #3a3f4a at 256 px (crop 56..456 × 0..400 scaled 0.64), chosen head circled MAGENTA, the other end circled CYAN, original socket as a small yellow dot, CHANGED frames with a red border; out/changes.json (cell, frame, old, new, margin); out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-sockets-fix"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
